flagged.title: Changing Relationships Within Families
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly teaches that the symmetrical family is Stage 4 of Willmott and Young's model rather than Stage 3, which misrepresents their sequence and would lose marks on exam questions testing their stages.

mark_affecting.quote: Willmott and Young argued that family history had gone through three stages, and in the 1970s, we were entering a fourth, the symmetrical family.
